releaseNotes.zh-CN:
主页新增虚拟 GPS、蓝牙、Wi-Fi 和基站总开关，关闭时保留应用配置。
环境多选删除支持已配置环境，并同步清除关联应用配置。
改善本地视频播放流畅度和相机录像兼容性。
修复录像声音替换，新增可选的麦克风混音。
releaseNotes.en:
Control virtual GPS, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi and cell data with a Home master switch while keeping saved app settings.
Delete configured environments in multi-select mode and remove their linked app settings together.
Improve local video playback smoothness and camera recording compatibility.
Fix recorded audio replacement and add optional microphone mixing.
